sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I am Emily. Today we will talk about
Izmir. Izmir is a big city in Turkey. It is next to the sea. Many people visit Izmir every year.
Izmir is a beautiful city with blue water and sunny weather. People love the beaches
and the sea. It is one of the oldest cities in Turkey. The weather in Izmir is warm most of the year.
In summer it is hot. In winter it is cool and rainy. People in Izmir are friendly and happy.
They like to walk near the sea, drink tea, and talk with friends. Izmir is famous for its
culture, history, and food. There are many things to see and do. Let's learn more about this amazing
city in the next part. Part two, history of Izmir. Izmir has a very long history. It is more than
3000 years old. In the past it was called Smyrna. Many people from different empires lived here.
The Greeks, the Romans, and the Ottomans. You can see history in many places in Izmir.
There are old ruins, castles, and ancient streets. One famous place is the Agora of Smyrna.
It is an old market from Roman times. Another is Kadefakale, an old castle on a hill. You can see
the city from there. Izmir was always an important port city. People came here to trade goods and
meet others from different lands. Today you can still feel history when you walk in Izmir.
The old and new parts of the city live together in harmony. Part three, famous people from Izmir.
Many famous people come from Izmir. One of them is the great Turkish singer Sezan Aksu.
She is called the queen of Turkish pop. People love her music. There are also many artists,
writers, and actors from Izmir. The city has a strong art culture. People love music,
painting, and theater. In the past Izmir was home to people from many countries and cultures.
This made the city rich in art and ideas. Many young people in Izmir study art and music.
They want to share their talent with the world. Izmir is proud of its creative people.
You can feel art everywhere in the city, in the streets, cafes, and markets. Part four,
nature, and the sea. Izmir is next to the AG and sea. The sea is blue and beautiful.
People love to swim and take boat trips. There are many beaches near the city.
Chechnya and Alachata are very popular places. Tourists come to swim, eat, and relax. The air in Izmir is fresh.
There are also parks and green areas where people walk and rest. You can see palm trees and flowers near the sea.
Sunsets in Izmir are amazing. People sit near the sea and watch the orange sky. It is a peaceful
moment. Nature in Izmir makes people happy. The city is full of life and beauty.
Part five, famous buildings and places. Izmir has many famous places to visit.
One of them is the Izmir clock tower. It is in Konak Square. The tower is a symbol of the city.
Nearby, there is a big market called Kemaralta Bazaar. You can buy clothes, spices, and souvenirs there.
There is also the old Asansur, which means elevator in Turkish. It helps people go up and down the hill.
From the top, you can see all of Izmir. You can also visit beautiful mosques,
churches, and museums. They show the city's long history. Izmir has many old and new buildings together.
It makes the city interesting and special. Part six, food in Izmir. Food in Izmir is very tasty.
People love to eat fresh vegetables, olive oil, and seafood. One famous food is Boyaz. It is a soft,
round pastry. People eat it for breakfast with tea. Another famous food is Kumru, a sandwich with
sausage, cheese, and tomatoes. Fish is also very popular. You can eat it near the sea.
The smell of fresh bread and fishes everywhere. People in Izmir love to sit at small cafes.
They drink Turkish tea or coffee and eat desserts like baklava. Food in Izmir is not only about taste.
It's about enjoying time with friends and family. Part seven, the people of Izmir.
People in Izmir are friendly and open. They smile and talk easily. They love their city very much.
Families often go to the seaside in the evening. They walk, talk, and eat ice cream.
People are relaxed and happy. They enjoy simple things. The sun, the sea, and good food.
Many people work in shops, hotels, or restaurants. Tourism is important for the city.
If you visit Izmir, people will help you find your way. They are kind and proud of their home.
Part eight, markets and shopping. Izmir has big and small markets. The most famous one is
Kemal to Bazaar. It is very old. People sell spices, sweets, jewelry, and clothes.
You can walk in small streets and see colorful shops. Sellers call out to people to come and look.
You can also buy handmade things. Many tourists buy souvenirs from Izmir.
Modern shopping centers are also popular. People go there for clothes, food, and fun.
Markets in Izmir are full of life. You can smell coffee,
see colors, and hear happy voices. Part nine, festivals in Izmir. Izmir has many festivals.
The Izmir International Fair is very famous. People from many countries come to show art, music, and products.
There are also music and film festivals. People love to celebrate culture.
In summer, there are concerts and open-air events. People dance and sing near the sea.
During national holidays, people put up flags and celebrate together.
Festivals in Izmir are full of color, music, and joy. You can feel the energy of the city.
Part ten, religion and culture. Izmir is a multicultural city. There are mosques,
churches, and synagogues. People from different religions live together in peace.
Culture is very important in Izmir. People like art, music, and books. You can see street musicians
playing near the sea. There are museums and galleries to visit. You can learn about the past
and see beautiful art. Izmir is also famous for kindness and hospitality.
People like to welcome visitors and share their traditions. Culture in Izmir is warm open and full
of life. Part 11, travel and tourism. Traveling in Izmir is easy. There are buses, trams, and fairies.
You can also take boats to nearby towns. Tourists visit historical places, beaches,
and mountains near the city. Ephesus, an ancient city, is close to Izmir. Many people visit it
every year. Hotels are comfortable and people are helpful. You can find food, music, and fun
everywhere. Izmir is a safe and happy city for travelers. You can enjoy both modern life and history.
I am Emily. Izmir is a city full of beauty, history, and sea. People are friendly and the food
is delicious. You can see old buildings, markets, and festivals. You can feel life and energy
everywhere in Izmir. It is a perfect mix of past and present. I hope you can visit Izmir one day.
You will love the people, the sea, and the sun. Goodbye, or as they say in Turkish, Hoshchakal.
